title: Phase 3: The New Men (Morph)
body: The morph completes as Veronese and adaptation collide in the archive. Scarcity dictates terms of reconciliation; branching truces fail against ambition's pressure. The civilizational wager settles not by love, but structural integrity of memory. Every institutional move recasts trust and resentment within the storyworld's unique causal trace.
reaction_rewrites: Houses fracture under mutual exposure, forcing a public wager on storyworld's future trajectory through new alliance geometries.
Adaptation against grind: speaker pivots tone to telegraph geometry while leaving traceable contradictions for later scenes.
